headline: PBOC DOUBLES DOWN: 14.93T GOLD BOUGHT IN JUNE — LARGEST SINGLE-MONTH PURCHASE SINCE 2023, 20-MONTH STREAK, 2,346T TOTAL
snippet: China's People's Bank of China added 14.93 tonnes of gold in June 2026 — its largest single-month purchase since 2023 and the 20th consecutive month of accumulation — lifting total reserves to 2,346 tonnes (75.44 million troy oz), per data released July 7. The buying occurred against the backdrop of gold's worst quarterly decline in thirteen years, signalling the PBOC treated price weakness as an accumulation opportunity rather than a deterrent. Beijing's gold strategy is explicitly framed as reducing US-dollar reserve concentration — gold still represents less than 10% of China's total reserves — meaning the structural buying mandate still has years of runway even at current prices. For retail precious metals investors, the confluence of a 20-month institutional buying streak and a price cycle low creates exactly the setup that has preceded outsized recoveries in prior central bank-driven bull cycles.

headline: FIRST MAJESTIC BEATS Q2, LIFTS 2026 SILVER GUIDANCE — 3.8MOZ AG FROM FOUR MEXICO MINES, SANTA ELENA SETS MILL THROUGHPUT RECORD (TSX:AG)
snippet: First Majestic Silver (TSX: AG) reported July 8 that Q2 2026 production reached 3.8 million silver ounces (+3% YoY) and 34,660 gold ounces (+2% YoY) from its four operating Mexican mines, with Santa Elena achieving a mill throughput record of 305,369 tonnes — 13% above Q2 2025 — driven by optimised feed blending between the Ermitaño and Santa Elena zones. The company simultaneously raised 2026 silver production guidance to 14.6–15.5 million ounces and gold guidance to 128,000–135,000 ounces, reflecting better-than-expected operational execution in the first half. At current silver prices near $59/oz, First Majestic's guidance raise carries direct cash-flow implications: every 1 million-ounce increase in annualised silver output at these prices translates to approximately $59 million in incremental revenue before costs, and the company operates without hedges. For investors tracking silver equity leverage, a guidance raise from the largest pure-play TSX-listed primary silver producer in the current price environment is a tier-one catalyst.

headline: GROUP ELEVEN STEPS OUT 50M AT BALLYWIRE: 6.9M AT 18.3% ZN+PB AND 86 G/T AG — IRELAND MASSIVE SULPHIDE NOW 3.2KM STRIKE (TSXV:ZNG)
source_name: Globe and Mail / Group Eleven Resources Corp.
snippet: Group Eleven Resources (TSXV: ZNG) released new assay results from the Ballywire discovery at its 100%-owned PG West Project in Ireland — four holes confirming step-out extensions in multiple directions — with hole 26-3552-60 intersecting 45.0m of 6.0% Zn+Pb and 28 g/t Ag including 6.9m of 18.3% Zn+Pb and 86 g/t Ag (with an inner 2.4m at 40.9% Zn+Pb and 185 g/t Ag), while a separate 275m step-out hole returned 4.7m of 67 g/t Ag and 0.88% Cu testing deeper copper-silver mineralisation beneath the main zinc slab. Confirmed mineralised strike length at Ballywire has expanded to 3.2 kilometres — a 600m addition from April — with four rigs currently active and a funded $12 million programme driving toward approximately 67,000–75,000 total metres. The 18.3% Zn+Pb grade in the 50m step-out exceeds most published comparable results from current active zinc discoveries globally and positions Ballywire as one of the highest-grade developing VMS-hosted zinc projects outside of Canada's Bathurst and Norway's zinc belts; Ireland's existing smelter infrastructure and access to Atlantic shipping give it a processing advantage that remote discoveries cannot match.

headline: GOLD BELOW $4,050, SILVER SHEDS $2/OZ IN 45 MINUTES — TRUMP DECLARES US-IRAN PEACE MOU 'OVER', OIL SURGES 5%
snippet: Spot gold dropped 1.3% to $4,050.92 and silver lost more than $2 per troy ounce within 45 minutes on July 8 after US President Trump — speaking at the NATO summit in Turkey — accused Tehran of double-dealing and declared the interim US-Iran peace memorandum of understanding "over," sending crude oil surging more than 5% and reviving inflation expectations that have suppressed metals for months. The move sharpens the market's dilemma: geopolitical deterioration that historically drives safe-haven gold demand is in this cycle being partially offset by the simultaneous inflation-then-rate-hike feedback loop, because oil above $80 raises the probability of a September Fed rate hike to 66% per current market pricing, and rate-hike expectations are dollar-positive and gold-negative. The current $4,050 level is 28% below January's $5,589 all-time high, but the PBOC bought its largest monthly tranche since 2023 during this same decline — suggesting institutional buyers view $4,000–$4,200 as a compelling entry range regardless of short-term headline noise.

headline: JAGUAR DEFINES NEW 15KM GOLD CORRIDOR AT PACIENCIA — FIRST-EVER DRILLING CONNECTS CHAMÉ TO BAHÚ ACROSS MINAS GERAIS DISTRICT (TSX:JAG)
snippet: Jaguar Mining (TSX: JAG) released July 8 the first drill results from its Paciência Trend exploration program in Minas Gerais, Brazil — 17 holes totalling 3,764 metres connecting four previously separate targets (Chamé, Santa Isabel, Marzagão, and Bahú) across a newly defined district corridor exceeding 15 kilometres in strike length. Key intercepts include 7.85m at 2.03 g/t Au and 32.21m at 0.37 g/t Au, consistent with the low-to-moderate grade profile typical of early-stage orogenic systems before structural controls and higher-grade shoots are fully defined. The existing Paciência underground resource already holds 189,000 oz Au at 4.14 g/t within 1.42 million tonnes at the Santa Isabel–Marzagão structure; the 15km corridor is a greenfield addition to this known resource base, with the Santa Isabel mine targeted for dewatering and rehabilitation toward a potential 2026 restart. For investors, the district-scale finding reframes Jaguar from a single-mine operator into a multi-target regional land holder in one of Brazil's most prolific gold belts.

headline: PREDICTIVE DISCOVERY KINIERO RUNS 50% ABOVE NAMEPLATE — 64,026 OZ AU POURED IN JUNE QUARTER, GUINEA MINE TRACKS ANNUAL GUIDANCE (ASX:PDI)
snippet: Predictive Discovery (ASX: PDI) reported July 8 that the Kiniero Gold Mine in Guinea poured 54,252 oz Au at throughput of 1,113 tonnes per hour — approximately 50% above its 6.0 Mtpa nameplate capacity — while the combined Nampala contribution lifted total quarterly output to 64,026 oz Au at 90.5% recovery, keeping the company on track for 157,000–174,000 oz annual guidance. Predictive now controls both the producing Kiniero mine and the multi-million-ounce Bankan gold project following its April 2026 merger with Robex Resources — a portfolio combination that gives it a producing cash engine funding exploration on one of West Africa's least-explored greenstone belts. If Bankan reaches production as planned in 2028, the company's projected output path toward 400,000+ oz annually makes the current ~64k quarterly production rate look like a first-phase baseline, not a ceiling.

headline: TOREX Q2 MORELOS: 96,297 OZ AUEQ FROM THREE MEXICO ZONES — H2 GRADE IMPROVEMENT ON TRACK FOR 420K-470K ANNUAL GUIDANCE (TSX:TXG)
snippet: Torex Gold Resources (TSX: TXG) reported Q2 2026 production of 96,297 oz AuEq (91,646 oz sold) from its Morelos Complex in Guerrero, Mexico — putting it at 197,171 oz AuEq year-to-date and on pace to achieve full-year guidance of 420,000–470,000 oz, with grades and recoveries expected to improve in H2. Morelos operates three ore sources simultaneously — El Limón Guajes open pit, the Media Luna underground, and satellite deposits — a production architecture that provides operational redundancy unusual for a mid-tier producer. At current gold prices and with H2 grades improving, Torex's $4,000+ gold price environment generates cash margins that management has historically returned through buybacks; Q3 will be the first full quarter with the benefit of sustained $4,000+ gold after a period of price weakness.

headline: EDGE COPPER SHIFTS ZONIA TO DEPOSIT-EXTENT DRILLING — 20 HOLES CONFIRM ARIZONA OXIDE CONTINUITY, RESOURCE UPDATE DUE Q4 2026 (TSXV:EDCU)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Edge Copper Corp.
snippet: Edge Copper (TSXV: EDCU) released July 8 assay results from nine additional holes at the Zonia Copper Project in Arizona, bringing the total reported for the current program to 20, with broad copper oxide mineralisation reinforcing continuity of the resource model across the infill grid. The company is now transitioning the balance of its 53,000-foot programme toward systematic deposit-extent drilling — the phase where infill work has established sufficient confidence in internal geometry and the program pivots to testing boundaries. A mineral resource update is targeted for late Q3 or early Q4 2026, the data point that will determine whether the Zonia deposit supports a revised PEA; Zonia already has a positive 2025 PEA and is fully permitted at surface in a jurisdiction — Arizona — where copper development has regulatory advantages relative to many western states.

headline: RARE EARTHS SWEEP: ALL 18 TRACKED ELEMENTS UP IN JULY — GERMANIUM +27.8%, INDIUM +26.5%, DYSPROSIUM +25.4% AS CHINA SQUEEZE BITES
snippet: Rare earth element prices posted a broad-based July advance with every one of 18 tracked elements rising — averaging +16.7% across the basket — led by germanium (+27.8%), indium (+26.5%), and dysprosium (+25.4% to $261.63/kg, its largest single-month move of the year), according to July 2026 market data. The rally marks the first genuinely uniform advance of the year after months of selective moves in individual elements; the structural driver remains a second consecutive year of supply deficit against EV motor and wind turbine demand, with China's export licensing requirement on key heavy rare earths tightening physical supply to Western downstream processors. For junior rare earth equities, a broad-basket rally that includes both heavy elements (dysprosium, terbium — used in EV motors) and critical technology metals (germanium, indium — used in semiconductors and solar) is meaningfully different from a neodymium-praseodymium spike: it signals system-level demand acceleration rather than a single-application inventory cycle, and it creates a pricing environment where projects across multiple element profiles simultaneously benefit.

headline: EKATI DIAMOND SALE CLOCK TICKING TO JULY 28 — 74% PRICE COLLAPSE FORCES CCAA PROCESS ON CANADA'S OLDEST DIAMOND MINE
snippet: Arctic Canadian Diamond Company Ltd. — the Burgundy Diamond Mines subsidiary that owns and operates the Ekati mine in Canada's Northwest Territories — obtained CCAA creditor protection in May 2026 and has until July 28 under a court-extended stay to identify a buyer or investor willing to restart the mine under a restructured ownership structure. The precipitating cause is a 74% decline in polished diamond prices driven by the mass-market emergence of lab-grown diamonds, which have permanently displaced natural stones in engagement ring purchases — the demand segment that sustained Ekati's operating economics. Canada's diamond industry, which once positioned itself as the ethical alternative to conflict diamonds, is now caught between a collapsing natural stone market and a mine whose remote NWT location makes break-even costs structurally high relative to synthetic competitors. For the mining community, the Ekati situation is a cautionary case study in commodity substitution risk: Ekati was considered a high-quality, long-life asset right up until a technological disruption made its product competitively obsolete.

headline: EQUINOX + ORLA SHAREHOLDER VOTE JULY 22 — CANADIAN CLEARANCES IN HAND FOR $18.5B COMBINATION, 1.1MOZ PRODUCER WEEKS FROM CLOSE (TSX:EQX)
snippet: Equinox Gold (TSX: EQX) will hold its special shareholder meeting July 22 to approve the share issuance that funds the all-stock acquisition of Orla Mining — creating a combined TSX/NYSE-listed gold producer with a total market value of approximately US$18.5 billion and six operating mines spanning Canada, the US, Nicaragua, and Mexico, with H2 2026 combined output targeting approximately 1.1 million oz AuEq annually. Canadian competition clearances have been secured, leaving only the July 22 shareholder vote and stock exchange approvals before a targeted Q3 close; Orla holders exchange 1:1 into Equinox shares with a nominal $0.0001 cash supplement. The deal represents a strategic milestone for the Canadian mid-tier gold space: Equinox was built through serial M&A from a small developer to a 500k-oz producer, and the Orla addition completes a jump to million-ounce status — the threshold at which gold miners typically attract institutional index inclusion and systematic fund allocation. Management transition sees Ross Beaty give way to Charles Jeannes as chair upon closing.
